name: stale_aggregate
description: In the POST /api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems/:l_linenumber/ship endpoint, when a lineitem's l_shipdate is updated, the parent orders.o_latest_shipdate is not recalculated. The GET /api/orders/:o_orderkey endpoint reads o_latest_shipdate directly from the orders table, which may now be stale since it depends on the maximum l_shipdate across all lineitems for that order.
